The preliminary phase completed one full 1920x1080 frame as 360 known-clean
11,520-byte transfers.

The valid Gate E phase completed six full 1280x720 frames as 864
uncompressed 12,800-byte transfers. Each is exactly 25 high-speed 512-byte
packets. Every bulk submit had transfer flags zero, and there was no
zero-length bulk submit.

All 1,224 bulk URBs completed with status zero and their full submitted
length. Usbmon and the Pi service journal agree on the payload count.
